title: populus schneideri var. tibetica
intro: Populus schneideri var. tibetica, commonly known as Tibetan poplar, is a deciduous tree species native to the high-altitude regions of the Tibetan Plateau. It has been traditionally used in Tibetan medicine to treat a range of health issues, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Tibetan poplar are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are exerted through its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Tibetan poplar have been shown to exhibit immunomodulatory, anti-proliferative, and anti-inflammatory activities, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine.
